headline: Long-read sequencing resolves haplotype, isoform and structural variant context
label: Structural Variant And Isoform Profiling
summary: Long-read and single-cell methods now resolve haplotypes, isoforms and structural variants across tumors, individual cells and brain transcriptomes.
synthesis: The common thread is long-read sequencing resolving genomic and transcript structure at the level of individual haplotypes, isoforms and structural variants. LongPhase-S reconstructs somatic haplotypes, estimates tumor purity and recalibrates somatic variants from paired long-read tumor-normal data. A Snakemake workflow builds haplotype-resolved, sample-specific proteomes from long-read RNA-seq and MS data. In single-cell settings, ScisTreeCNA infers lineage trees from SNVs and CNAs, Amaranth refines splicing graphs using UMI-linked and internal reads, and CRISPore-seq resolves isoform-level alternative splicing under pooled CRISPR perturbation. Structurally, variable fusion transcripts across 312 human brain transcriptomes cluster in segmental duplication hotspots. What is new is integrating variant and isoform context into interpretation: NMD escape rules gain 12.0% explanatory power when MNVs, translation status and isoform expression are incorporated into annotation.
